summary: Diff adds frontend-visible backend connection status (banner + status hook), a backend connectivity-check endpoint, and a startup connectivity check in the sync hook. It also updates the prompt editor to block saving when canSave is false. However, there is no clear evidence of a production canister/actor configuration fix (REQ-4), and actor-creation error reporting appears to use a synthetic error rather than surfacing the underlying actor creation failure details.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix production configuration so the frontend creates the actor against the correct backend canister ID in live; fail fast with a clear English misconfiguration error if runtime config is missing/invalid.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary shows new diagnostics/hooks and a connectivity check, but no changes are shown to the actor factory/configuration path (e.g., createActorWithConfig, env/canister ID resolution, production build-time/runtime config validation).
evidence: <file-diff>: no modified files indicating changes to actor factory/config used by frontend (only new hooks/components and App wiring shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Expose actor creation status (loading/success/error) and the underlying error message/details to the UI layer, and ensure failures are logged with enough context (error message/stack, auth state, principal).
missing_requirements.reason: A status hook is added, but it creates a new generic Error("Backend actor creation failed...") rather than surfacing the underlying actor-creation error details. The UI banner supports an errorMessage prop, but the hook only stores the synthetic error and the diff excerpt does not show wiring of the underlying error/stack from actor creation into UI state.
evidence: frontend/src/features/backend/useBackendActorStatus.ts (creates synthetic Error; no capture of underlying actor creation error)
frontend/src/components/backend/BackendConnectionBanner.tsx (expects errorMessage but does not itself derive underlying actor creation error)
frontend/src/App.tsx (truncated; does not show passing detailed actor error message into banner)

missing_requirements.requirement: Prevent saving prompts/categories while backend connection is not ready; disable/block Save until backend actor/API is initialized; avoid normal-startup toasts saying exactly "Not connected to backend".
missing_requirements.reason: Prompt editor save is guarded via canSave/statusMessage, but the requirement also includes categories. The diff excerpt does not show similar blocking/disabled behavior for category save flows (e.g., ManageCategoriesDialog operations). Also, usePromptLibrarySync still imports toast and may still surface connection errors as toasts; the excerpt is truncated before CRUD wrappers where the exact toast text behavior would be determined.
evidence: frontend/src/components/categories/ManageCategoriesDialog.tsx (mentioned in summaries, but diff content not shown for save-blocking)
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptLibrarySync.ts (imports toast; truncated before operation wrappers where "Not connected to backend" could be emitted)
